page.overview:
Who is Little Willie?

William Terry, best known as Little Willie, is a Ventrue antitribu and the dedicated scout for The Dead Gypsies, a nomadic Sabbat pack.

William Terry earned the moniker "Little Willie" while serving time in prison. During his short and violent mortal life, he was a small-time drug dealer operating in Detroit, and witnessed his older brother gunned down right in front of his eyes. Willie desperately wanted a way out of his circumstances but had no means of escape – until the Sabbat arrived to recruit him.

Following his Embrace, Willie became an excellent scout for The Dead Gypsies, demonstrating overwhelming loyalty and intense bloodlust. Despite his dedication, he never truly felt accepted by the pack until he was formally accused of being an infernalist. It was only the unwavering support of his packmates that saved him from meeting the Final Death at the hands of the Sabbat Inquisition. He has felt fiercely beholden to the coven ever since and will do anything to protect them.

Equipment: Mini-Uzi, Glock 22, silvered sword, two knives
